name: NOVAST
summary: NOVAST Laboratories, Limited develops, manufactures, and sells prescription drug formulations. The company produces controlled-release formulations, including extended-release and sustained-release tablets and capsules, as well as low-dose drug formulations. Its products include Metoprolol Succinate Extended-Release Tablets, Nifedipine Extended-Release Tablets, Diltiazem Hydrochloride Extended-Release Capsules, Metformin Hydrochloride Sustained-Release Tablets, Levonorgestrel Tablets, Memantine Hydrochloride Extended-Release Capsules, Quetiapine Fumarate Sustained-Release Tablets, and Tolterodine tablets for urinary frequency and urgency.
